name: Data Preview Clarification
implementation_notes: Dual-mode component (list/detail driven by :id? route param), mirrors DataPreviewBoilerRoomView.vue's watch()-driven mode switch exactly

Detail mode renders the Clarification Detail grid read-only straight from stored columns (no recomputation, historical data), however many rows the record actually has, plus an empty-state message for zero rows
Checked By/Acknowledged By rendered read-only with no role restriction on viewing, consistent with Data Preview Boiler Room and this screen's business spec

UNLIKE Data Preview Threshing/Boiler Room: this screen has NO operational-target reference table section, per this station's explicit scope; all 7 non-time_slot detail columns (6 numeric + Findings) are rendered in the detail-row grid, the simplest field set of any station in the project

REVISI (tech-spec v2, kunci periode usecase-141 — sinkronisasi artefak, kode tidak diubah): mode detail memasang RecordVerificationActions (station-type='clarification', local-table='clarification_record') yang memanggil PATCH /api/records/clarification/{server_id}/verification; backend RecordVerificationService::setVerification menerapkan peran + cakupan mill lalu assertPeriodOpenForWrite (EnforcesPeriodLock) atas `date` record sebelum menulis — periode stasiun tidak terbuka / tanggal di luar rentang → 422 PERIOD_CLOSED tanpa perubahan kolom; komponen menampilkan pesan server dan baris lokal tidak diperbarui (UPDATE lokal hanya setelah sukses); offline → pesan 'Butuh koneksi internet untuk verifikasi'. Tercakup oleh backend/tests/Feature/Api/RecordVerificationTest.php (blok 'kunci periode pada jalur verifikasi') dan backend/tests/Unit/Support/EnforcesPeriodLockTest.php; mobile/tests/recordVerification.spec.ts mencakup galat offline tetapi belum punya kasus PERIOD_CLOSED khusus.

known_issues.description: Browser (Playwright) e2e spec was not authored for this screen in this task -- component test coverage (DataPreviewClarificationView.spec.ts, 11 tests) is complete and passing, but there is no browser-level verification of this screen's list/detail navigation flow in a live dev server.
